description: This course covers foundational concepts of cloud computing including IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, and hybrid cloud architectures; virtualization technologies like KVM and Xen; security frameworks such as ISO/IEC 27001 and NIST Cybersecurity Framework; encryption algorithms like AES and RSA; identity management systems like OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect; threat modeling techniques using STRIDE; secure API design with OAuth and JWT; cloud security compliance standards like GDPR and HIPAA; and incident response strategies in cloud environments. It also includes hands-on labs on setting up secure cloud infrastructures using AWS and Azure, implementing multi-factor authentication, and analyzing security vulnerabilities in cloud-based applications.

clos.text: Define cloud computing service models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) and deployment models (public, private, hybrid) with specific examples from AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.
Explain virtualization technologies (KVM, Xen) and their role in cloud infrastructure security.
Apply encryption algorithms (AES, RSA) and key management practices to secure cloud data at rest and in transit.
Implement identity and access management solutions (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect) for cloud-based applications.
Evaluate cloud security compliance requirements (GDPR, HIPAA) and design secure cloud architectures that meet these standards.

topics: Introduction to Cloud Computing and Security

Lab: Configure SIEM Tools for Cloud Security Monitoring
Lab: Develop Cloud Incident Response Plan
Lab: Implement DevSecOps Practices in Cloud CI/CD
Lab: Secure Configuration of Cloud Infrastructure
Lab: Finalize Cloud Security Architecture and Presentation
